projectDescription: Lilac is an AI agent workspace that connects to your existing tools, runs tasks in its own cloud environment, and keeps you informed so work moves forward even when you step away.
keyFeatures: AI agent that runs tasks autonomously in a cloud environment
Built-in code editor for reviewing and editing files
Connect to MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools and integrations
Model selection to choose the best AI for each task
Plan limits and usage quotas per account tier
GitHub, Notion, Gmail, and Calendar integrations
Live task progress visible in the workspace thread
Waitlist-gated early access with Google and GitHub sign-in
